content.comment_body: Hello. Can anyone assist? I'm trying to write a value in [product_name] (eAQ) using [product_name], and I want to create a block in [product_name] so the measurement shows correctly. Currently, it's displaying the value 32767. This measurement relates to [product_name]. The block entered in [product_name] is [article_no] (vm mapping type word). In the [product_name] message text, I enter block [article_no], and the record works for [product_name] measurements. How can extended analog output eAQ from [product_name] be displayed in [product_name]? An image is attached. Looking for help. Thank you.
Hello [user_name], the value is too high for [product_name]. It can only handle INTEGER values in the range -32768 to 32767. That's why the value is capped at 32767.
Try changing the resolution in the block properties from 0.100 to 1.000.
You solved my issue. It works perfectly now. Thank you.
Glad to help! Just remember, if the value exceeds 32,767 again, the issue will return.
You can display the eAQ value from the F/I converter on the [product_name] display in a message text, but it will not show decimal places. Calculating with eAQ is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience limitations when transferring extended analog output (eAQ) values from [product_name] into [product_name], due to integer overflow and absence of decimal precision. [product_name] only supports integer values between -32768 and 32767, which leads to errors when larger or non-integer values are required. Adjusting block settings can provide a temporary fix, but core restrictions on value range and precision remain.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to reliably transmit and display analog values, including those above 32,767 and values with decimals, in [product_name] without accuracy loss or errors.
